title: Resident Benefits Schedule: Residency Loyalty Reduction on Respite Extension Nights
content:
Long-standing Larkspur independent living residents who extend a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement receive a residency loyalty reduction on the added nights.

**Schedule entry.** The residency loyalty reduction on added nights is three percent (3 percent) of the added-night charges where the guest's active Larkspur independent living residency began at least sixty whole months (60 whole months) before the current date, one percent (1 percent) where it began at least twenty-four (24) but fewer than sixty whole months before, and nothing otherwise.

**What it reduces.** The added-night charges are the billed added nights times the price of an added night; the reduction is taken on that product, and on nothing else in the extension charge.

**Records read.** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and its move-in date; whole months are counted from that move-in date to the current date.

| Active Independent Living Residency Agreement | Whole months since move-in | Reduction on the added-night charges |
|---|---|---|
| Held | 60 or more | 3 percent |
| Held | 24 to 59 | 1 percent |
| Held | Fewer than 24 | Nothing |
| Not held | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

Added-night charges of 6 nights at 279.50, that is 1,677.00, for a guest whose active residency began 64 whole months ago, are reduced by 3 percent to 1,626.69 before the extension charge's single rounding.
